morphology.pattern_note: -kan 形成及物动词，词根末尾 r 保留。hiburkan 常用于祈使句，也用于 saya hiburkan 等人称代词被动结构；正式主动陈述通常用 menghiburkan。输入包误把 hiburkan 标为词根，此处依 [DBP hibur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=hibur)修正；空缺音节与爪夷据构词补全。

word_family.gloss: 艺人；带来欢乐或慰藉的人或事物

senses.zh_definition: 使人开心或得到娱乐；在祈使句中表示“逗……开心、为……助兴”。
senses.en_definition: To entertain or amuse someone; imperatively, entertain or cheer them up.
senses.nuances: 强调带来愉悦，宾语常为 penonton、tetamu 或 hati。独立使用时通常是指令；叙述某人正在娱乐观众，一般用 menghiburkan penonton。

senses.zh_definition: 安慰或开解悲伤、失落的人，使其心情好转。
senses.en_definition: To console or comfort someone who is distressed.
senses.ms_definition: Melipurkan hati orang yang sedih atau berdukacita.
senses.nuances: 重点是减轻悲伤，不一定靠笑话或表演；有时陪伴、倾听也能达到这个意思。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场 / 活动主持指引
dual_scenarios.ms: Hiburkan para peserta dengan aktiviti yang sesuai sementara menunggu majlis bermula.
dual_scenarios.zh: 在等待典礼开始期间，请通过适当的活动为参与者增添乐趣。
dual_scenarios.en: Keep the participants entertained with suitable activities while they wait for the ceremony to begin.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Tolong hiburkan adik kejap, dia dah mula menangis.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Tolong hiburkan adik sebentar kerana dia sudah mula menangis.
dual_scenarios.zh: 帮忙哄一下弟弟，他开始哭了。
dual_scenarios.en: Can you comfort your little brother for a minute? He's started crying.
spoken_features: tolong 缓和祈使语气；hiburkan 保留 -kan。

messages.speaker: Farah (姐姐)
messages.ms_spoken: Tolong hiburkan adik kejap, dia dah mula menangis.
messages.ms_standard: Tolong hiburkan adik sebentar kerana dia sudah mula menangis.
messages.zh: 帮忙哄一下弟弟，他开始哭了。
messages.en: Can you comfort your little brother for a minute? He's started crying.

messages.speaker: Amir (哥哥)
messages.ms_spoken: Boleh, aku nak duduk kat sebelah dia dulu. Mungkin dia nak teman je.
messages.ms_standard: Boleh, saya akan duduk di sebelahnya dahulu. Mungkin dia hanya mahu ditemani.
messages.zh: 可以，我先坐到他旁边。可能他只是想有人陪。
messages.en: Sure, I'll sit beside him first. Maybe he just wants some company.

etymology.historical_story: Hiburkan is a Malay formation from hibur and -kan. Its word family links public entertainment with private consolation: a singer may be a penghibur, while a grieving person may feel terhibur through companionship. DBP's learner dictionary also recalls listening to recited verse as hiburan, connecting the vocabulary with storytelling and shared listening. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=hibur).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: hibur 是“让心情好起来”，加 -kan 把作用带给对象：hiburkan dia，“逗他开心／安慰他”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说 Hiburkan dia! 带命令感；对同事或不熟的人宜用 Tolong hiburkan dia 或 Boleh bantu hiburkan dia?。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于娱乐、陪伴和安慰。面对丧亲或重大打击，应先倾听并判断对方需要，避免把“逗开心”理解成必须开玩笑或要求对方立刻高兴。
